integrity: Analytic proof plus standalone exact-rational test file. Self-review only; no independent validation or priority claim of exhaustive novelty.
scientific_limitations: Unequal complete bipartite graphs K_{p,q}, p,q >= 2, uniform unit edge conductances, unperturbed two-stage third-order Radau IIA endpoint only. Roots determine nonnegative step domain but no closed inequality deciding overlap for all side ratios. Intermediate stages, directed and other graph families remain outside scope. Historical overlap is incompletely searched.
title: Two forbidden step intervals for Radau IIA diffusion on unequal complete bipartite graphs
